subject.title: [Bug]: memsearch-summarize sub-session compaction fails with "No API provider registered for api: ollama" on 2026.7.1, while main-session compaction with the same provider succeeds

question: Which exact commit fixed fresh-process explicit-session Ollama compaction, and should it ship through the next stable release or a v2026.7.x backport?
rationale: Current main passes while the latest stable release fails, so branch selection and cherry-pick safety require release-owner intent rather than another implementation PR.

options.title: Include in next stable
options.body: Identify the fixing SHA, verify the explicit-session Ollama path, and keep this issue open until the normal next stable release contains it.

options.title: Backport to v2026.7.x
options.body: Cherry-pick the narrow fixing commit onto the release branch after focused fresh-process compaction and upgrade validation.

recommendation.title: Include in next stable
recommendation.body: Identify the fixing SHA, verify the explicit-session Ollama path, and keep this issue open until the normal next stable release contains it.

likelyOwner.reason: He signed v2026.7.1 and has direct history on the shared compaction stream boundary needed to trace and release the fix.
